title: Movers & Shakers
author: daphni
description: Launched in 2015, daphni is a fund that aims to support entrepreneurs who want to give meaning to their work, including, to name but a few, those at Back Market, Swile, Hubcycle, and Karavela. You may be familiar with our whimsical offices on Rue Réaumur and our superb team, or perhaps you don't know us at all. It doesn't matter, because this podcast isn't about us, but rather about our community: the investors, entrepreneurs, and experts who are the cornerstone of our mission to build the world of tomorrow together. Enjoy To learn more about us: https://daphni.com/ Hébergé par Audiomeans. Visitez audiomeans.fr/politique-de-confidentialite pour plus d'informations.
